'''Ruby''' is a gem found in [[Bastion Remnant|bastion remnants]]. It is used to buy the [[Ruby Circlet]] from the [[Jeweler]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Chest loot ===
One ruby is guaranteed in every bastion bridge, hoglin stable and treasure room chest.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/chests/bastion_treasure.json}}</ref>
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
=== Trading ===
{| class="wikitable"
! Villager !! Level !! Wants !! Gives
|-
| [[Jeweler]] || Apprentice || 4 × {{ItemLink|Obol}} + {{ItemLink|Ruby}} || {{ItemLink|Ruby Circlet}}
|-
| [[Jeweler]] || Master || {{ItemLink|Ruby}} || 8 × {{ItemLink|Obol}}
|}
<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/toolsmith/5/sell_ruby.json}}</ref>
A ruby can either be turned into [[jewelry]] or sold back to a Master-level Jeweler for 8 [[Obol]]s.

== Advancements ==
Obtaining a ruby grants ''Canto II'' ("Pillage the Remnants of Pandaemonium") in the [[Advancements/Tutorial|Tutorial]] tab, which rewards a [[Crystal Heart]]. It follows ''Canto I''.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/obtain_ruby.json}}</ref>

== History ==
{{History|
{{History line|0.4-alpha|Gems can now be sold to the Jeweler.}}
{{History line|1.12.3|Now built on a poisonous potato instead of a fermented spider eye, so it no longer counts as a fermented spider eye in recipes.}}
}}

== Trivia ==
* Like the other gems, ruby is built on a poisonous potato; through 1.12.2 it was built on a fermented spider eye.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/item_modifier/ruby.json}}</ref>
